purpose: Test whether topology-restricted terminal-child preplacement retains the large E09 latency/QPR benefit of V156 without allowing nonterminal descendants to reserve scarce HPA-created containers and reduce completed throughput.

paper_sequence_gate.homogeneous_middle_and_high_historical_b: retain unchanged and do not rerun

causal_diagnosis.v156_success: The three-seed QPR sum and both complete-cohort means passed; E09 latency fell from 139.07 ms to 74.10 ms and QPR rose from 0.06917 to 0.13145.
causal_diagnosis.v156_failure: Unrestricted pipeline placement reduced E09 and E20 completions by 241 and 312, respectively, leaving only one of three diagnostic throughput wins and 11 of 20 complete-cohort wins.
causal_diagnosis.mechanism: Parents-scheduled eligibility admits unfinished descendants. Preplacing every such descendant can reserve HPA-created containers before it can execute. Terminal children are completion-proximal: their preplacement directly removes the last cold/transfer barrier, while nonterminal descendants can consume capacity without completing a request.
causal_diagnosis.falsifiable_prediction: Admit every parents-completed player plus only parents-scheduled terminal players. This should preserve the E09 latency/QPR gain while reducing speculative capacity occupation and restoring throughput pairs.

single_mechanism_change_from_v155.ready_players: unchanged: admit after every parent completes
single_mechanism_change_from_v155.pipeline_ahead_players: admit only if the immutable DAG marks the function terminal and every parent has an assigned node
single_mechanism_change_from_v155.rejected_pipeline_players: nonterminal functions whose parents are assigned but not all completed
unchanged: queue density threshold 8.0 and exact V155 scoring router
NSESche solver, welfare, pricing and feasibility
common HPA, tapes, metrics and policy-independent references

allowed_inputs: current queue density used by the unchanged V155 router

checks: exact E09, E18 and E20 product/order with no additional seed or baseline
valid QC, ledger, archive inventory, runtime identity and offline reference pairing
every admitted pipeline-ahead player is terminal and has every parent assigned
every nonterminal parents-scheduled-but-incomplete player is excluded and counted
at least one terminal pipeline-ahead player and one rejected nonterminal pipeline player are observed
every queue route matches the unchanged V155 threshold-8 router and both routes occur
zero performance or aggregate outcome fields are parsed before audit sealing

diagnostic_selection_rule.evaluation: Replace only V155 E09, E18 and E20 with V157 and recompute the unchanged complete E01-E20 gates.
diagnostic_selection_rule.throughput_paired_gate: at least 12 of 20 wins, including at least 2 of 3 diagnostic wins
diagnostic_selection_rule.qpr_mean_gate: both QPR conventions strictly greater than OCS 0.055577160345697
diagnostic_selection_rule.qpr_paired_gate: at least 12 of 20 wins with 20 of 20 finite-only values
diagnostic_selection_rule.joint_diagnostic_pass: every listed gate passes without editing this plan
diagnostic_selection_rule.failure: retain all three valid V157 diagnostics, retire V157 and continue mechanism analysis without running the other seventeen
diagnostic_selection_rule.success: authorize a separately committed remaining-seventeen V157 training plan reusing these three rows
